title: Genesis 9:16-18 — The everlasting covenant; the sons of Noah
summary: Genesis 9:16-18 in English: God will look on the bow in the cloud to remember the everlasting covenant with every living creature, tells Noah the bow is the sign of the covenant, and names Noah's sons who came out of the ark: Shem, Ham and Japheth, with Ham the father of Canaan. The words covenant, God, Noah, ark and the sons' names are colour-coded.

text.text: 16 “When the bow is in the cloud, then I will look upon it, to remember the everlasting covenant between God and every living creature of all flesh that is on the earth.”
17 And God said to Noah, “This is the sign of the covenant which I have established between Me and all flesh that is on the earth.”
18 Now the sons of Noah who came out of the ark were Shem and Ham and Japheth; and Ham was the father of Canaan.
